name: Input
description: A single-line text field. One appearance, no variants — every input in the studio looks the same on purpose.

props.name: type
props.description: The native input type. Passed straight through — the component adds no behavior of its own.

root.description: One field. Height and radius are fixed; the ring is the only thing that changes.

gaps.why: One field height keeps forms aligned. A different height is a form-layout decision, not a component one.

gaps.what: No built-in label, hint or error text.
gaps.why: Those are a Field's job — an input that owns its own label cannot be laid out beside another one.
